{{Top|leg}}
A '''planetarium''' was a type of building in which images of [[Star/Legends|stars]], [[Planet/Legends|planets]], and [[Constellation/Legends|constellations]] appeared on a high, domed ceiling, either for entertainment or education. While most modern planetariums were made of [[Hologram/Legends|holograms]], older exemplaries featured physical models of celestial bodies, such as the [[Jedi Temple Planetarium]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TFU">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>

{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
The wealthy businessbeing [[UCKR.E.M. IV]] was known for selling portable planetariums.<ref name="MAGL">''[[Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas]]''</ref>
{{Noncanonend}}
